context: New ErrorBoundary component to wrap risky widgets (like third-party charts) so a render crash shows a fallback instead of blanking the whole app.
explanation: Safe to merge. getDerivedStateFromError sets state during the render phase so React can immediately swap in the fallback UI, while componentDidCatch runs as a side effect afterward to log the error — using both together is the correct, documented pattern. The reset button and optional onError callback are clean, low-risk additions.
